reconstruction_summary: Re-ran V4 (understeer K_us scaling -> per-segment bias removal -> per-segment integer-sample cross-correlation lag shift) using agent's fitted K_us=1.559e-05 from out/fit.txt; per-segment bias and lag re-fit on each canonical segment as the agent's recipe specifies.
notes: Reconstructed V4 (favourite, headline 14.5% on Mach-E only): understeer K_us correction with agent's fitted K_us=1.559e-05, then per-segment bias removal, then per-segment integer-sample time-alignment (max +/- 15 samples). Agent's K_us was fit on Mach-E only (315 segs); applied unchanged to F-150 Lightning here. Per-seg bias/lag are re-fit per segment as the recipe specifies, so each F-150 segment gets its own bias/lag.
